sources.title: Llama 3.3 — FuriosaAI Developer Center 2026.4.0b13 documentation
sources.snippet: Llama 3.3 # Llama 3.3 is Meta's instruction-tuned, auto-regressive dense transformer optimized for multilingual dialogue, instruction following, and tool usage, with quality competitive with much larger models. Furiosa-LLM runs Llama 3.3 in FP8 using the RedHatAI FP8-dynamic recipe (static FP8 weights with dynamic FP8 activation quantization).

sources.title: furiosa-ai/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct is Meta's 70B instruction-tuned model, an auto-regressive dense transformer optimized for multilingual dialogue, instruction following, and tool usage, with quality competitive with much larger models. Its intended use is the same as the upstream meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, and it is released under the Llama 3.3 Community License.
